title: shell_process arguments
description: The arguments of the browser server's shell_process tool (input.tool is "shell_process"): reading and ending commands that shell_execute started with background: true. It cannot start anything, so a policy that decides which commands may start only needs to look at shell_execute.

id.description: The id shell_execute returned. Required for poll and kill, not accepted by list.

wait_ms.description: poll only: wait up to this long for the command to exit before answering.

signal.description: kill only: the signal sent to the command's process group.
